Actual evapotranspiration of a scene with a preset

Source: R/api-earthflux.R
earthflux.Rd

Runs the complete METRIC workflow for one area and one date: downloads and prepares the MODIS surface state (Terra LST, albedo, NDVI, LAI) and the NASADEM elevation model on the native 1 km MODIS grid, prepares the weather forcing from a station table or from ERA5 (Open-Meteo), regionalizes the reference evapotranspiration and the wind, selects the anchor pixels, calibrates the sensible heat flux and returns the daily actual evapotranspiration with every intermediate layer, the objects of each stage, flags and provenance.

Every scientific option is set by the preset (no default, decision M5-04): see ef_presets() for the list and ef_preset() for every option of one preset. The same computation can be run step by step with the ef_*() functions (expert level).

Usage

earthflux(
  aoi,
  date,
  weather,
  preset,
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("EarthFlux", "cache"),
  apikey = NULL,
  surface = NULL,
  terrain = NULL
)

Arguments

aoi

Area of interest: a SpatVector of polygons in any CRS (e.g. read with terra::vect()). It must lie in one MODIS sinusoidal tile (tile mosaics are not assembled yet); the result is NA outside the polygon.

date

Date of the scene (UTC day of the MODIS LST). No default.

weather

The weather source, no default: "era5" for hourly ERA5 data downloaded from the Open-Meteo historical weather API (no credential; CC BY 4.0, non-commercial use of the free API, decision M5-07), or an hourly station table built with ef_station_table(). With one station its values are used over the whole area (C1); with several stations (or ERA5 cells) they are interpolated by inverse distance weighting as the preset says (C2). The stations must cover the overpass time, the local day of the scene and the 24 hours before it.

preset

Character, no default: the name of a preset ("idaho2002_elev" or "idaho2002_flat", see ef_presets()).

cache_dir

Character. Directory of the download cache (MODIS, NASADEM and Open-Meteo files), default tools::R_user_dir("EarthFlux", "cache"). Valid cached files are reused without network access.

apikey

NULL (default) or the key of the Open-Meteo customer API (commercial use), used only with weather = "era5". It is sent only to the API and never stored: the provenance records apikey_used.

surface

NULL (default: downloaded and prepared) or an earthflux_surface_state prepared beforehand with the MODIS options of the preset (expert route).

terrain

NULL (default: downloaded and prepared) or an earthflux_terrain on the working grid of surface (expert route).

Value

An object of class earthflux_result (a list):

  • layers: SpatRaster on the working grid (MODIS sinusoidal, about 1 km), NA outside the AOI polygon, with the layers eta_24 (daily actual ET, mm d-1), etrf (-), et_inst (mm h-1), le, h, g, rn (W m-2), rah (s m-1), dt (K), rs_in, rl_in, rl_out (W m-2), tau_sw (-), zom (m), u_blend, u_star (m s-1), ts_datum (K), air_density (kg m-3), pressure (kPa), etr_inst (mm h-1) and etr_24 (mm d-1) of the reference (alfalfa);

  • units: named character vector of the units of layers;

  • surface (earthflux_surface_state), terrain (earthflux_terrain), weather (the station table, its QC and the reference ET of the stations, ef_station_ref_et()), forcing (the regionalized surfaces of etr_inst, wind_speed_2m and etr_24 at their target times, the method and the mid-points), anchors (earthflux_anchors with their boundary conditions) and h_calibration (earthflux_h_calibration);

  • qa: flag words per stage, never combined bit by bit: surface (the words of the surface state), forcing (GWR stage, one layer per variable at the overpass time of each cell), metric (flags_rad, flags_g, flags_h, flags_et) and their flag_bits;

  • flags: earthflux_flag records of the run: object and record flags of the forcing (e.g. EF_WS_GRIDDED_FORCING, EF_GWR_SINGLE_STATION), the anchors and the calibration, and the cell flags of the METRIC chain on the cells of the grid (with target = layer);

  • provenance: the preset (name, version, status, unverified elements), every effective option, the values derived for the scene (overpass times, day and UTC offset of the daily reference ET, regionalization method, datum elevation, ...), the counts of excluded cells, the MODIS granules, the NASADEM tiles, the Open-Meteo request (without key) or the station table, attributions, the codes evaluated, versions, the future plan and timings.

Details

Order of the workflow (dev/specs/presets.md section 2): (1) area checks and refusal of areas over several MODIS tiles before any download; (2) MODIS search, download and surface state; (3) cells outside the AOI polygon and cells with a critical surface flag (albedo above 1) are excluded and counted; (4) NASADEM elevation on the working grid (cells below the minimum valid fraction excluded); (5) weather table (station table or ERA5) and its quality control; (6) hourly and daily alfalfa reference ET of the stations; (7) regionalization of the hourly reference ET and wind at the hourly mid-points around the overpass and of the daily reference ET; each cell takes the values at its own overpass time (linear interpolation between mid-points); (8) solar geometry, pressure, roughness and wind at 200 m; (9) anchors, selected before the net radiation because the incoming longwave uses the temperature of the cold anchor (P0-3); (10) shortwave and longwave radiation, net radiation, soil heat flux; (11) boundary conditions at the anchors and calibration of dT; (12) LE, instantaneous ET, ETrF and daily ETa. Values are never filled or truncated: excluded or undefined cells are NA and flagged or counted.

Errors: missing or unknown preset (earthflux_missing_input, earthflux_unknown_method), invalid inputs (earthflux_input_error), an AOI over several tiles (earthflux_method_not_implemented), weather that does not cover the scene (earthflux_weather_coverage_error), missing Earthdata token (earthflux_credentials_error), download failures (earthflux_download_error), anchors without candidates (earthflux_anchor_no_candidates) and the errors of the stages.

Verification status

The workflow only orchestrates; the status of each formulation is that of the function used. The status of the preset as a whole (today CANDIDATA for both) is recorded in the provenance and announced by a warning of class earthflux_unverified_preset_warning that lists the unverified elements (decision M5-08). Results are not validated (milestone M6).

Credentials and licences

MODIS and NASADEM need a NASA Earthdata token in the environment variable EARTHDATA_TOKEN (generate it at urs.earthdata.nasa.gov). The token is never printed, stored or written to the cache. ERA5 data from Open-Meteo are licensed CC BY 4.0 (attribution in the provenance); the free API is for non-commercial use.

References

Waters, R., Allen, R., Bastiaanssen, W., Tasumi, M., & Trezza, R. (2002). SEBAL: Surface Energy Balance Algorithms for Land. Idaho implementation. Advanced training and users manual (Version 1.0). University of Idaho and Idaho Department of Water Resources.

Allen, R. G., Tasumi, M., & Trezza, R. (2007). Satellite-based energy balance for mapping evapotranspiration with internalized calibration (METRIC) - Model. Journal of Irrigation and Drainage Engineering, 133(4), 380-394. doi:10.1061/(ASCE)0733-9437(2007)133:4(380)

See also

ef_presets(), ef_preset(); the ef_*() functions for the expert level.

Other workflow functions: ef_preset(), ef_presets()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Needs network access and EARTHDATA_TOKEN (NASA Earthdata).
aoi <- terra::vect(terra::ext(-72.8, -71.9, -36.3, -35.6),
                   crs = "EPSG:4326")
res <- earthflux(aoi, date = as.Date("2019-02-15"), weather = "era5",
                 preset = "idaho2002_elev")
res
summary(res)
plot(res)
} # }
